description: Refresh the STIR/SHAKEN trust material from the STI-PA, or upload roots or a CRL by hand: send 'action', or 'kind' and 'pem' (and, for roots, 'role')

action.description: 'refresh' fetches the trusted CA list and the CRL from the STI-PA named by stipa_api_url and stores both

kind.description: What 'pem' is: trusted roots (see 'role') or the certificate revocation list, or the certificate that signs it

pem.description: The bundle or CRL as PEM text

role.description: For kind 'ca' only, what the uploaded roots are for: 'stipa' pins the STI-PA root the CA list's and the CRL's signers must chain to, and never anchors a call; 'calls' is an extra anchor for call certificate chains, and never pins the STI-PA. Absent means 'calls'. An upload replaces the roots of its role only
